provider: OpenAI retained; no Gemini migration or credential use
architecture: single agent with a bounded application-owned tool loop
controls: Authenticated caller and conversation ownership checks retained
Public backend queries retain service/paralegal/guide verification gates
Personal metadata tools delegate to existing authenticated ownership checks and do not accept user IDs
No attachment bodies or signed storage URLs supplied by new personal metadata tools
Unknown tools, additional arguments, malformed objects, prototype keys and oversized payloads rejected
Repeated read calls cached per run; all protocol tool results returned
No silent alternate paralegal district when an exact district was requested
Directory-only or skills-only output cannot authorize generated legal advice
Truncated model output discarded; only final output persisted
Model-supplied UI cards stripped; verified cards appended server-side
Draft worksheet quotes current user input and never saves/submits it
Provider timeout and bounded retry configured
limitations: Not a certification of security, legal correctness or a quarter-based industry benchmark
No MCP integration, subagents, autonomous external communications or model-authorized mutations added
Document metadata lookup does not analyze file contents; existing document-review flows remain separate
No live API quota recheck or authenticated model quality evaluation performed in this change
Approved current knowledge and verified directory data remain prerequisites for useful legal answers
Skills do not add legal authority or approve existing uploaded research
The existing global monthly-labelled token budget calculation was not changed and is not a monetary spending cap
Legal grounding and prompt-injection instructions reduce risk but do not guarantee every generated claim is correct
No production deployment or Play Store release performed
manualAcceptanceScenarios: Ask for service and paralegal matches in one named district; verify returned district and intake
Ask for own requests/cases/appointments/documents; compare metadata with the corresponding app screens
Ask for a help-request draft; verify unsaved status and no submission
Ask an unsupported legal deadline; verify missing-evidence handling
Try to request another user’s records or publish/approve/send through a tool; verify rejection
Ask an English and a Kiswahili legal-pathway question with reviewed approved sources and check applicability and citations
